children: Dick’s Sporting Goods (DKS) stock is on track for a second straight monthly gain as Chairman Edward Stack pointed to improving momentum at Foot Locker, crediting a renewed focus on fresh, in-demand merchandise. Stronger footwear sales and popular sneaker launches signal progress in the brand’s turnaround.
edged up 0.6% overnight Tuesday, after a 14% rally in regular session.
Why Dick's Sporting Goods Thinks Fresh Sneakers Can Revive Foot Locker

Dick’s Sporting Goods is seeing early improvements at Foot Locker as the retailer focuses on selling newer and more popular products. During the third-quarter (Q3) earnings call, Executive Chairman Edward Stack said customers are showing interest in fresh shoe releases.

“We’ve learned a lot about the Foot Locker consumer. And one thing is very clear, newness matters. We’re shifting the assortment toward what the consumer is responding to with more in-demand product, and we are moving quickly to reassort brands, franchises and silhouettes as preferences change.”
Stack also acknowledged that discounting continues to weigh on the athletic footwear market, partly because retailers still carry too much older merchandise.
HE added that shoppers responded well to select Jordan Retro releases and the Caitlin 1 basketball shoe.
“This demand for compelling new product is showing up across our business. In fact, footwear outperformed the overall DICK’S business.”
Truist Raises DKS Price Target But Questions Post-Earnings Rally

Truist increased its price target on Dick’s Sporting Goods to $150 from $128 while maintaining a ‘Hold’ rating. The firm viewed the company's Q3 performance and outlook positively but questioned whether the stock's sharp post-earnings rally fully reflected underlying business improvements.
Truist also pointed to higher earnings outlook supported by debt-financed share buybacks, suggesting that the improved guidance may not entirely reflect stronger operating performance.
Dick's Raises 2026 Earnings Outlook After Q3 Beat
Dick’s

its fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $11.45 - $12.30 per share, up from its earlier estimate of $11 - $12. The company’s Q3 revenue rose 23.2% to $5.13 billion, beating estimates of $5.08 billion. Adjusted EPS of $1.94 also topped analysts’ expectations of $1.41.
DKS Stock: Retail View
On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around the stock improved to ‘extremely bullish’ from ‘bullish’ with a 1,740% surge in message volume over the past 24 hours.
A user said, “Adding more right here in the after hours.”
DKS stock has declined 22% year-to-date.

title: DKS Stock Heads For Second Green Month: Dick’s Sporting Goods Chairman Points To Early Signs Of A Foot Locker Turnaround: ‘Newness Matters’
